posters.title: CV against a job ad
posters.story: As a hiring manager I want each CV checked against each line of my job ad, so I read the strong ones first and stop paying an LLM to reread every CV in full.

posters.title: Shop bot, answer or hand off
posters.story: As a small shop owner running a website and phone bot, I want the bot to answer what its configured facts cover and hand everything else to staff, so customers never hear an invented price, stock level or booking.

run.question: Can the bot answer this customer message using only the fact sheet, or must it hand off to staff?
run.reason: not enough evidence: Jev is not shown within 10 points of the LLM (lower bound of Jev minus LLM -0.11, not above -0.10)

posters.title: Requirement evidence check
posters.story: As a builder before a demo I want each requirement in my spec checked against the evidence I hold for it, so I know which ones are met, partly met or not met without rereading everything.

posters.title: Tech stack choice
posters.story: As a user I want Jev to decide on my tech stack for my project.

posters.title: Website slop roast
posters.story: As a website builder I want to use Jev!Jev to roast and score my website as AI slop so that I can fix it and win awards for awesome web apps.
